clue.text: Seasonal activity potentially applicable to 9, 11, 12 (yes, really), 19, 21A, 24, 1D, 7, 20, 22 and 23?

definitions.meaning: the Scottish New Year custom of being the first visitor across the threshold after midnight

explanation.walkthrough: 'yes, really' admits that a foot-lambert, a unit of brightness, is a real word. Each listed answer takes FOOT in front to make a new term.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hogmanay custom of being the first guest of the New Year is the seasonal activity; the second reading describes placing a body part first.

clue.text: Forces everyone to tuck into odd bits of fish
